skill.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
skill.description: Creates premium mobile app screen images and coherent multi-screen flows for iOS, Android, and cross-platform product concepts. It focuses on readable hierarchy, strong art direction, controlled color, consistent phone mockups, and app-native presentation.
skill.summary: Creates premium, app-native mobile screen images and flow concepts.
skill.author: leonxlnx

content.value_statement: Mobile app image concepts often look generic, crowded, or inconsistent. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished mobile screen images and coherent flows.
actual_capabilities: Generates mobile app screen images and multi-screen flow images.
Selects iOS, Android, or cross-platform visual direction before generation.
Keeps screen sets consistent through palette, typography, spacing, and mockup rules.
Uses clean phone mockup framing by default for app presentation.
Prioritizes readable text, safe areas, navigation logic, and short product copy.
Applies category-specific guidance for fintech, wellness, commerce, social, and productivity apps.
limitations: It generates images only and does not write application code.
It does not replace production-ready design specifications or accessibility testing.
Exact native component behavior depends on later implementation work.
Image quality depends on the available image generation model and prompt context.

use_cases.title: Explore a New App Concept
use_cases.description: Create a visual direction and first screen set before detailed product design begins.

use_cases.title: Pitch a Mobile Product Idea
use_cases.description: Generate polished app screens that show the idea, mood, and core user flow clearly.

use_cases.title: Compare Flow Directions
use_cases.description: Produce alternate onboarding, commerce, wellness, or productivity flows for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic App Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one clear concept screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one premium iOS screen image for a calm habit tracking app. Use readable text, generous spacing, and a clean phone mockup.

prompt_templates.title: Three-Screen Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a small product journey.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-screen Android flow for a personal finance app: welcome, dashboard, and transaction detail. Keep the palette controlled and trustworthy.

prompt_templates.title: Category-Specific Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed request for a branded mobile product direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a premium commerce app concept for handmade furniture. Include browse, product detail, cart, and confirmation screens with strong product imagery.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Visual System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for art direction and flow consistency.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-screen cross-platform wellness app flow. Use soft texture, short copy, consistent typography, custom-feeling icons, and balanced phone mockups.

output_examples.input: Create a premium fitness app concept.
output_examples.output: A consistent set of phone-framed mobile screen images showing onboarding, today view, workout detail, and progress states.
A polished commerce flow with browse, product detail, cart, checkout, and confirmation screens using consistent product imagery.

output_examples.input: Make an onboarding flow for a social app.
output_examples.output: Multiple onboarding screens with varied layouts, short copy, readable typography, and one coherent visual system.

best_practices: State the app category, platform, screen count, and target mood in the prompt.
Ask for separate screens when readability matters more than a single overview board.
Include brand cues, audience context, and core flow steps for better consistency.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to write SwiftUI, Flutter, React Native, or HTML.
Do not request a dense collage when each screen needs readable detail.
Do not leave the app category and platform unstated for complex flows.

faq.question: Does this skill generate code?
faq.answer: No. It generates mobile app screen images and flow images only.

faq.question: Can it create both iOS and Android concepts?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports iOS-native, Android-native, and cross-platform premium directions.

faq.question: Does it create multiple screens?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for single screens, multi-screen flows, onboarding, commerce, and app concepts.

faq.question: Will it include a phone mockup?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses a clean visible phone frame by default unless the prompt asks for raw screens.

faq.question: What makes this different from a generic UI prompt?
faq.answer: It enforces app-native structure, flow logic, readable text, controlled palettes, and consistent mockup framing.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for early mobile product exploration, pitch visuals, design direction, and flow comparison.
